path_placeholder: Paste a folder path, drop a folder here or use Browse…
guide_content:
1. Choose a folder: Browse, drag it onto the window, paste its path or pick a recent one. Mapping starts automatically.
2. Explore the tree: click the arrow or double-click a folder to open it, double-click a file to open it.
3. Search: type in the search field to find files and folders anywhere in the map. Double-click a result, or use "Show in tree", to see where it is.
4. Filter by type: click a file type in the chart or legend; click it again to remove the filter.
5. Right-click (or the ⋯ button) for file actions: open, show in Explorer, copy path, cut/copy/paste, duplicate, rename, delete.
6. Export map: preview the tree, copy it to the clipboard or save it as a UTF-8 text file.
7. Refresh (F5) after changes made outside Mapper.

Move "{name}" to the Recycle Bin?
You can restore it from there.
preview_lines: Preview of the full map · {total} lines.
error_invalid_name: Invalid name. Avoid \ / : * ? " < > |, trailing dots or spaces and reserved names like CON.
error_name_exists: An item with this name already exists.
error_outside_root: This item is outside the mapped folder.
error_root_locked: The mapped folder itself cannot be renamed, duplicated or deleted.
error_copy_into_self: A folder cannot be copied or moved into itself.
error_source_missing: The item to paste no longer exists.
error_trash: Could not move the item to the Recycle Bin. Nothing was deleted.
scan_errors_intro: These items were skipped while mapping; everything else is in the map.
error_path_changed: The item changed after it was selected. Nothing was done: refresh the map (F5).
links_skipped: Done, but {count} links (junctions or symbolic links) could not be recreated and were not copied.
error_pattern: An exclusion pattern is not valid. Nothing was changed.
preview_partial: Preview of the first {shown} lines. Copy and Save include everything.
exclude_patterns: Other items to skip, one pattern per line (.gitignore style)
hashing: Saving the snapshot and computing file fingerprints (SHA-256)… Esc cancels
snapshot_invalid: This file is not a valid Mapper snapshot, or it is damaged.
snapshot_not_mapper: This JSON file is not a Mapper snapshot.
snapshot_newer: This snapshot was made by a newer version of Mapper.
snapshot_no_metadata: This export has no sizes and dates: use Compare → Save snapshot.
snapshot_duplicate: The snapshot lists the same item twice: it may have been edited by hand.
snapshot_too_large: The snapshot is too large to be compared safely.
snapshot_unreadable: The snapshot file cannot be read.
save_snapshot_hashes: Save snapshot with fingerprints (slower, more precise)…
compare_with_snapshot: Compare a snapshot with this map…
detail_folder: folder moved with all its content, from {path}
detail_size_date: probably, same size and date, from {path}
compare_hint: Content changes are proven by size or fingerprint; dates alone never count as a content change.
all_excluded_title: Everything here is excluded by your rules
unreadable_hint: Windows denied access or the path is no longer available.
run_program_text: “{name}” is a program or script: opening it runs it on this computer. Continue only if you trust where it comes from.
